title: Three cavern layers rotated with the surface on CTRL for a season. Land and cavern layers managed: every in-embark entry allowed and assigned by the matrix, groups on (one scheduler over every layer, as v5.7 ships it), coupling and ecology off. 100,800 ticks, two replicates. Every 3,000 ticks the wild units are counted per layer and the groups status printed. Questions: do cavern arrivals follow their assigned seasons; does a gated or resident cavern group stop surface waves (the scheduler's max_concurrent counts every layer today).
fork: v5.8 cavern rotation and the per-layer scheduler: whether one gate serves every layer or each layer needs its own quota.

predictions.expects: surface arrivals stop while cavern groups fill the concurrent slots; per-layer quota needed
surface and cavern arrivals continue side by side; a shared scheduler is enough

kill_criterion: surface arrivals per 10,000 ticks with cavern groups present vs absent decides the per-layer quota; any out-of-season cavern arrival fails the rotation
culling: drop the replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: layers
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; cfg.layers.land=true; cfg.layers.water=false; cfg.layers.cavern=true; local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local n,c=0,0; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and sw.defaultAllow(e) then cfg.allow[e.key]=true; n=n+1; if e.layer~='land' then c=c+1 end end end; local a,f=sw.assignFromMatrix(cfg,pool); cfg.groups.enabled=true; cfg.groups.coupling=false; cfg.ecology.enabled=false; sw.saveConfig(cfg); local act=sw.applyLive(cfg, df.global.cur_season); sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); print(('roster: land + cavern layers — %d allowed (%d cavern), %d assigned, %d thin, %d applied; groups on, coupling off, ecology off; rotation enabled'):format(n,c,a,f,act))

do: local by={}; for _,u in ipairs(df.global.world.units.active) do if dfhack.units.isWildlife(u) and not dfhack.units.isDead(u) and not u.flags1.inactive then local r=u.animal.population; local L=(r.cave_id>=0) and ('cavern'..r.cave_id) or ((r.feature_idx>=0) and 'water' or 'surface'); by[L]=(by[L] or 0)+1 end end; local parts={}; for k,v in pairs(by) do parts[#parts+1]=k..'='..v end; table.sort(parts); local ok,out=pcall(dfhack.run_command_silent,'seasonal-wildlife','groups'); print(('e21 layers: %s | %s'):format(table.concat(parts,' '), (out or ''):gsub('\n',' | '):sub(1,400)))
